root_cause.text: The SAI driver's probe function acquires a reference to the sync provider OF node but fails to release it on all probe error paths and on driver unbind, causing an OF node reference leak and a potential use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `of_node_put(sai->np_sync_provider)` in error paths of `stm32_sai_sub_parse_of()`, in the error path of `stm32_sai_sub_probe()`, and in `stm32_sai_sub_remove()`. It also modifies `stm32_sai_set_sync()` to no longer drop the reference, delegating the release to the caller which now always does so via these added calls. The CVE description confirms that the reference was only dropped if `set_sync()` fails during DAI probe, not on other probe failures or driver unbind.
